title: Dark, rainy basement garage
summary: The basement garage is now dark and foggy, lit by humming fluorescent tubes that flicker, with rain falling through the central opening.
notes: Darken the basement garage with local fog and dim ambient light while you are inside.
Generate humming fluorescent ceiling tubes on every floor; lower floors have more dead and flickering tubes.
Replace the developer grid textures with weathered concrete, ceiling and hazard-rail textures.
Add rain, rain sound and a wet pool to the central atrium.
